description: A task-local character design proposal (CF-WO-P1-004, Task C). Created when a script needs a character that has no approved registered identity. It is a PROPOSAL for one production job only: it never registers a character, never writes to the character registry, and never becomes permanent without the existing explicit-authorisation registration flow. Approved identities always win over proposals. Every generated scene must reference the proposal id (or the approved character id) so no face, body proportion or clothing drifts without an explicit story-driven variation. This schema carries no reference images and no timestamps: reference preparation is recorded as required reference artefacts (front, side, turnaround, expression sheet, poses), and approved reference identifiers are recorded only once they exist.

accessories.description: Accessories the character wears or carries.

appearance.description: Fixed visual structure of the proposed character. Once approved for the job, this structure is the anchor every scene must match.

body_proportions.description: Body proportions (for example slim 8-year-old build, tall adult, stocky).

distinctive_features.description: Distinctive features that must stay consistent (for example freckles, a scar, a gold leaf hair accessory).

face_structure.description: Face structure (for example round face, big dark-brown eyes).

hairstyle.description: Hairstyle (for example very long curly chestnut-brown hair with side braids).

approved_reference_ids.description: Approved reference identifiers for this proposal, once reference artefacts exist and are approved. Empty until then; a proposal with no approved references cannot be used for generation.

character_ref.description: How the script refers to this character (name or description as written in the script).

clothing.description: Clothing for the character in this production. Clothing may change with the scene; the change is recorded per scene, never silently.

design_brief.description: The design brief: who this character is, in production terms.

expression_requirements.description: Expressions this character must be able to perform in this production.

job_id.description: The production job this proposal belongs to, once bound to a job.

permanent_registration_requested.description: Whether permanent registration has been requested for this proposal. False by default; a proposal never registers itself. Permanent registration still requires the existing explicit authorisation and consent flow.

personality.description: Personality and visible mannerisms (for example curious and brave; fiddles with a sleeve when nervous).

project_id.description: The project this proposal belongs to.

provenance.description: A design proposal is always inferred for production unless the user explicitly described the character. A proposal must never claim to be user-supplied or canon.

reference_preparation.description: Which reference artefacts must be prepared before this character can be generated consistently.

expression_sheet_required.description: Whether an expression sheet is required.

front_reference_required.description: Whether a front reference is required.

pose_references.description: Pose references required for this production.

side_reference_required.description: Whether a side reference is required.

turnaround_required.description: Whether a character turnaround is required.

role.description: The character's story role (for example protagonist, antagonist, supporting, narrator).

status.description: draft: being written. proposed: ready for the user to review. approved-for-job: approved for this job only (still not registered). rejected: not used.

visual_style.description: Visual style for this character (for example 2D flat cartoon, stylized 3D, photorealistic digital human).

title: Character Design Proposal
